This document lists the testing procedures P1, which must be 
performed 
on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The T60 differential protection devices are 
 designed for the fast and selective short circuit protection of 
 transformers, motors and generators and of other two, three or four phase 
 winding arrangement.

This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the relay. It is 
recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases.

The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft initiated by eng. Reda Easa, tested 
by eng Sidhom Nasef, revised by MDEP Quality control eng. Adel El-Naggar, 
accepted by eng. Ali Zahran, general manager, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head 
sector of Nubaria PS, certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general director, and 
approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection and quality 
control.

Steps to
prepare for
relay
testing

items:
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolate the relay current circuits for test.

Ensure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying a DC voltmeter 
 across points (B5a, B6a) on the rear of the relay.

items: Connecting the personal computer to the relay.

Connecting the Personal Computer to the ISA tester.
Be sure that ISA tester is connected to EARTH.
Switch ON ISA tester.

After ISA tester completely in service connect currents, voltages and binary 
 input leads between ISA tester and test plug for T60.

RUN ISAWIZARD software >>>>> GENERATION & DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> Xpro

items: Insert the test plug in the terminal block BP14 or BP16 (see figure 1).
Do not forget to GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=0V].

A-1 choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the 
 relay.

A-2 choose Shoot with current value equal to 1.05 of pick up current to get 
 pickup time of the relay.

A-3 to test 2nd stage of differential, disable 1st stage of differential 
 then shoot by setting current.
B-1-Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 100Hz for 2nd harmonic test
B-2-Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 250Hz for 5th harmonic test.
Choose STORE ALL TESTS >>>>

Go to RESULTS from main menu chose HEADER and apply all information about 
 these FEEDER and OK
Now print the results and you have complete test results for these relay.

Store all tests

GENERATE Pre-fault Condition

sections.text:
Return relay and 
associated equipment to 
service

items:
Return relay to service by removing the test leads from the relay terminals 
 and the test set.
Make sure CT and V T secondary circuits are in normal condition.
Remove the disturbance alarm LED`s on the relay which is caused by the test.
Request feeder to be returned in service.

Take pharos readings of all AC currents and voltages and compare them to 
 those for normal load condition.

Check that these reading agree with station meters (MW,
 Mvar, Amperes and Power 
 Factor).
Place a copy of the test result in the field maintenance file.

Introduction
This document lists the testing procedures P1, which must be 
performed 
on an annually bases 
as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The T60 differential protection devices are 
 designed for the fast and selective short circuit protection of 
 transformers, motors and generators and of other two, three or four phase 
 winding arrangement.
This procedure details the steps required to 
completely check the proper operation and calibration of the relay. It is 
recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases.
The document is formatted the way to minimize the 
possibility of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.
The first draft initiated by eng. Reda Easa, tested 
by eng Sidhom Nasef, revised by MDEP Quality control eng. Adel El-Naggar, 
accepted by eng. Ali Zahran, general manager, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawan head 
sector of Nubaria PS, certified by eng. Samir abdel Gilil: general director, and 
approved by eng. Mohammed Nageb: head sector of MDEPC inspection and quality 
control.
Safety Precautions
A work 
 permit must be issued.
The maintenance staff should be trained, qualified, and carry the suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety 
 Helmet, safety shoes 
 ... etc.
Equipment isolation and grounding 
is required.
Make sure that CT secondary circuits are shorted before isolating the current 
 circuits for testing the protection relay.
Tools and Equipment
Safety Helmet, safety shoes ... etc
ISA DRTS tester, Test leads.
PC laptop with necessary software {ISAWIZARD and ENER VISTA}

Preparation
Make sure CT secondary circuits are shorted at the incoming terminal blocks 
 before isolate the relay current circuits for test.
Ensure that the DC power of the relay is correct by applying a DC voltmeter 
 across points (B5a, B6a) on the rear of the relay.

Connecting the personal computer to the relay.
Run the Enervista program.
Read the setting and safe it as URGENT FILE FOR T60 [Name the feeder].
For Main Transformer of CTG
Differential Protection Test
Connecting the Personal Computer to the ISA tester.
Be sure that ISA tester is connected to EARTH.
Switch ON ISA tester.
After ISA tester completely in service connect currents, voltages and binary 
 input leads between ISA tester and test plug for T60.
RUN ISAWIZARD software >>>>> GENERATION & DISTRIBUTION RELAYS >>>> Xpro 
 advanced >>>> MANUAL MODE
NOW you can test the relay.
Insert the test plug in the terminal block BP14 or BP16 (see figure 1).
NOTE:
Do not forget to GENERATE PREFAULT CONDITION [I=0.001A, V=0V].
A-1 choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the 
 relay.
A-2 choose Shoot with current value equal to 1.05 of pick up current to get 
 pickup time of the relay.
A-3 to test 2nd stage of differential, disable 1st stage of differential 
 then shoot by setting current.
2nd and 5th harmonic 
restraining test
B-1-Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 100Hz for 2nd harmonic test
B-2-Repeat steps from A-1 with frequency 250Hz for 5th harmonic test.
Choose STORE ALL TESTS >>>>
Go to RESULTS from main menu chose HEADER and apply all information about 
 these FEEDER and OK
Now print the results and you have complete test results for these relay.
Earth Fault
RUN ISAWIZARD software and choose GENERATION AND DISTRIBUTION RELAY >>>> 
 X-PRO >>>>MANUAL MODE>>>>
Insert the test plug in the terminal block BP15 (see figure 1).
Generate Pre-Fault Condition [I=0.001A].
Disable distance function .
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay
Select fault and shoot current value equal to (I Setting*1.05) to determine 
 the operating time.
 Note: that: the injection should be on phase R only.
Store all tests
Restricted Earth Fault
Disable earth fault and differential protection functions
Insert the test plug in the terminal block BP15 (see figure 1).
GENERATE Pre-fault Condition 
 [I=0.001A].
Choose Delta ramp with step ∆I 0.05 Amp to get pickup current of the relay
Select fault and shoot current value equal to (I Setting*1.05) to determine 
 the operating time.
STORE ALL TESTS
Now you have complete test results for these relay
